initiative.title: Business Lanes Marketing Growth Implementation
initiative.summary: Turn the marketing-growth playbook into an execution-ready draft packet with campaign analysis boundaries, channel constraints, and owner handoff gates.

taskset.summary: Publish a draft campaign-readiness packet and decision triggers from the marketing-growth lane contract.

tasks.title: Create marketing campaign-readiness evidence packet for owner review
tasks.goal: Prepare a reusable marketing campaign-readiness packet (constraints, claims, channels, and evidence expectations) that can be promoted to implementation only after owner approval.
tasks.scope: Draft marketing execution packets only; no channel actions, message dispatch, or ad platform mutations.
acceptance: Marketing lane draft packet exists with required outputs and in-scope/out-of-scope boundaries.
Channel actions are explicitly marked as draft/owner-gated and do not require direct agent-side execution.
Decision trigger and external-effect safeguards are explicit.
Task and unit evidence commands are reproducible.

units.title: Draft marketing growth campaign-readiness packet
units.context: This unit publishes a markdown packet in WORK-LANE-PLAYBOOKS that standardizes campaign-readiness structure and marketing decision gates.
units.scope: Docs only: marketing campaign-readiness packet draft and approval boundaries.
steps: Draft a marketing evidence packet section under Marketing-Growth with packet schema and draft-only fields.
Add explicit constraints for channel activity, messaging hygiene, and approval owner.
Define decision triggers for campaign execution and external partner/channel escalation.
Record W4 verification commands and evidence references.
acceptance: Marketing growth packet is present and explicitly marked draft-only.
Scope-out boundaries include external campaign execution restrictions.
Task and unit evidence commands are deterministic and measurable.
units.stop_condition: Stop after marketing packet draft and closeout evidence links are ready for owner review.
units.handoff: Report marketing readiness draft packet location, approval triggers, and verified evidence.
